package handlers

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
)

func TestBuildTaskResponseIncludesLearningTargets(t *testing.T) {
	response := buildTaskResponse(&domain.Task{
		LearningTargets: []domain.TaskLearningTarget{
			{Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability, Key: "learning.semantic-sequence", Version: "v1"},
			{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "program.instructions.sequence"},
		},
	}, nil, nil, true, true, nil)

	if len(response.LearningTargets) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected task projection: targets=%+v", response.LearningTargets)
	}
	if response.LearningTargets[0].Type != domain.LearningTargetCapability || response.LearningTargets[0].Version != "v1" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected first target: %+v", response.LearningTargets[0])
	}
}
